dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Hello, are you an outlander who came to Inazuma too? Ah, we've become a real rare sight recently.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: I'm a merchant from Snezhnaya. I've been staying at Inazuma to get some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: The climate of Inazuma is warm and humid, and its cuisine is most exquisite. It's a far more forgiving place than Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Let's chat again next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business been?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: It was quite good at first. Exotic items from faraway lands will sell well anywhere, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: But later on, the Resistance emerged in Sangonomiya due to the confiscation of Visions by the Shogunate. Business has gotten worse ever since that war started.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: That just won't do. How can there be a healthy market in this environment? The way I see it, the Shogunate is stabbing itself in the foot... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: But though the current situation is grim, the weather in Inazuma remains very comfortable. And Komore Teahouse is very safe and secure. So all in all, I'm in no hurry to leave, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you often drink tea here?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Komore Teahouse is classy, has a fascinating view and is very cautious in choosing its guests. It is the best place for me to relax.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Walking around in the yard, watching the scenery and listening in to the chitchat of the guests are my favorite pastimes.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: I have felt that I am being watched by somebody lately. It does creep me out...

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: But since I am already inside Komore Teahouse, I suppose I will be fine...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you wind up here?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, you mean why I'm not stuck in Ritou even though I'm an outlander?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Well... Komore Teahouse only serves useful individuals. That's all I can say.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business been?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: It was quite good at first. Exotic items from faraway lands will sell well anywhere, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: But later on, the Resistance emerged in Sangonomiya due to the confiscation of Visions by the Shogunate. Business has gotten worse ever since that war started.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: That just won't do. How can there be a healthy market in this environment? The way I see it, the Shogunate is stabbing itself in the foot... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: But now that the Sakoku Decree has been abolished, I think things should pick up here again. I mean, life resurges wherever the blood flows, am I right?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: I mean, the weather in Inazuma remains very comfortable. And Komore Teahouse is very safe and secure. So all in all, I'm in no hurry to leave, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you get here, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, you mean why I didn't wind up stuck in Ritou even though I'm an outlander, even back during the days of the Sakoku Decree?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Well... Komore Teahouse only serves useful individuals. That's all I can say.
